## Notes

- A tampered number can escape detection only when the new value happens to match another fact in the same table within rounding tolerance (for example a changed rank that equals another integer fact). The verifier checks provenance against the whole table, not position.
- Numbers that are labels, not facts (evidence IDs, ISO generation date, data version, satellite names, fixed citations and data sources) are stripped before checking.
